projects.title: Rhythm Game
projects.subtitle: A dynamic rhythm game with responsive gameplay.
projects.label: GAMEPLAY / MUSIC
projects.intro: A four-lane rhythm game with music-synced note charts, precise timing judgements, and a neon playfield. Supports keyboard and touch controls, with an in-world guitar performance.
details: Four-lane tap and hold gameplay synced to music.
Timing judgements, combo multipliers, and scoring.
Performance meter with fail and replay support.
Neon visuals with keyboard and mobile controls.

projects.title: Concert Music System

Vote skip, autoplay, volume control, and Concert Mode.
